content.title: How to watch Mets vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 14
content.text: The New York Mets hope to end their six-game losing run against the Los Angeles Dodgers, at 10:10 p.m. ET on Tuesday. Yoshinobu Yamamoto (2-1, 2.50 ERA) will start for the Dodgers, who are 12-4 this season and first in the NL West. Nolan McLean (1-1, 2.70 ERA) is the expected starter for the Mets, who are 7-10 and fifth in the NL East.How to watch New York Mets vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 10:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SportsNet LA and SNY Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 25% strikeout rate and a 6.3% walk rate in 64 plate appearances, and he has scored nine total runs. Pages has recorded two steals on three attempts. In 71 plate appearances, Freddie Freeman has slashed .273/.324/.485 this season. He has hit three long balls and driven in 13 runs (14th in MLB) with a strikeout rate of 11.3% and a walk rate of 5.6%. He has come around to score eight times. New York’s Luis Robert is slashing .300/.435/.420 this season with two home runs, seven RBIs and an OPS of .855. He has a 21% strikeout rate and a 19.4% walk rate in 62 plate appearances, and he has scored nine total runs. Robert has recorded two steals on three attempts. In 51 plate appearances, Francisco Alvarez has posted a 17.6% strikeout rate and a 9.8% walk rate while slashing .302/.388/.605 with four home runs (18th in MLB), four RBIs and six runs scored.
